description: This source file contains definitions for models and data structures related to scheduling and managing cron jobs, including enums for targets, modes, schedules, payloads, and classes for cron job state, job details, events, and logs. It appears to be part of a larger system for job scheduling and automation.

classes.name: CronJob
classes.description: Represents a scheduled cron job with attributes like schedule, payload, delivery, and state, including methods for retrieving parsed session targets and display properties.

classes.name: CronJobState
classes.description: Tracks the runtime status of a cron job including last and next execution times and last error details.

classes.name: CronEvent
classes.description: Captures details about a cron job execution event including start time, duration, status, and error info.

classes.name: CronRunLogEntry
classes.description: Logs individual run entries for cron jobs, including timestamps, status, errors, and durations.

classes.name: CronListResponse
classes.description: Response structure encapsulating a list of cron jobs.

classes.name: CronRunsResponse
classes.description: Response structure for a list of cron job run logs.

methods.name: from(_ value: String) -> CronCustomSessionTarget
methods.description: Creates a CronCustomSessionTarget instance from a string, identifying predefined or custom session IDs.

methods.name: parseAtDate(_ value: String) -> Date?
methods.description: Parses a string into a Date object for 'at' schedule types, supporting ISO date formats.

methods.name: formatIsoDate(_ date: Date) -> String
methods.description: Formats a Date object into an ISO8601 string without fractional seconds.

methods.name: makeIsoFormatter(withFractional: Bool) -> ISO8601DateFormatter
methods.description: Creates and configures an ISO8601DateFormatter with or without fractional seconds for date conversions.
